meta.time_rule: Email receipt time is retained. Forwarded/prior-period remarks retain their described horizon; no historical knowledge-availability ledger exists. This snapshot is descriptive and cannot be used as a point-in-time backtest.
meta.labels: Desk tone is a categorical synthesis of reviewed direct views (recent 14–21 Sep where available, otherwise earlier window). Mixed preserves opposing arguments. Research/news/management relays cannot populate desk tone or positioning. No new numerical crowding score is fitted.
meta.highlight_rule: Five editorial research priorities per group, selected from explicit company-level passages. Not a quantitative rank, buy/sell recommendation or measured weekly change.
